shortDescription: Configures vHBA templates on Cisco UCS Manager

options.name: description
options.description: A user-defined description of the template. Enter up to 256 characters. You can use any characters or spaces except the following: ` (accent mark),  (backslash), ^ (carat), " (double quote), = (equal sign), > (greater than), < (less than), or ' (single quote).

options.name: fabric
options.description: The Fabric ID field. The name of the fabric interconnect that vHBAs created with this template are associated with.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of Cisco UCS Manager. Modules can be used with the UCS Platform Emulator U(https://cs.co/ucspe)

options.name: max_data
options.description: The Max Data Field Size field. The maximum size of the Fibre Channel frame payload bytes that the vHBA supports. Enter an string between '256' and '2112'.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the virtual HBA template. This name can be between 1 and 16 alphanumeric characters. You cannot use spaces or any special characters other than - (hyphen), "_" (underscore), : (colon), and . (period). You cannot change this name after the template is created.

options.name: org_dn
options.description: Org dn (distinguished name)

options.name: password
options.description: Password for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.

options.name: pin_group
options.description: The SAN pin group that is associated with vHBAs created from this template.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used during connection (by default uses 443 for https and 80 for http connection).

options.name: proxy
options.description: If use_proxy is no, specfies proxy to be used for connection. e.g. 'http://proxy.xy.z:8080'

options.name: qos_policy
options.description: The QoS policy that is associated with vHBAs created from this template.

options.name: redundancy_type
options.description: The Redundancy Type used for template pairing from the Primary or Secondary redundancy template. primary — Creates configurations that can be shared with the Secondary template. Any other shared changes on the Primary template are automatically synchronized to the Secondary template. secondary — All shared configurations are inherited from the Primary template. none - Legacy vHBA template behavior. Select this option if you do not want to use redundancy.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), will verify vHBA templates are present and will create if needed. If C(absent), will verify vHBA templates are absent and will delete if needed.

options.name: stats_policy
options.description: The statistics collection policy that is associated with vHBAs created from this template.

options.name: template_type
options.description: The Template Type field. This can be one of the following: initial-template — vHBAs created from this template are not updated if the template changes. updating-template - vHBAs created from this template are updated if the template changes.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), will not use the proxy as defined by system environment variable.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(no), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.

options.name: vsan
options.description: The VSAN to associate with vHBAs created from this template.

options.name: wwpn_pool
options.description: The WWPN pool that a vHBA created from this template uses to derive its WWPN address.
